subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the method used to prepare a soluble salt from a metal and an acid.

subtopics.name: Metal carbonates and acids
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe the reaction between a metal carbonate and an acid, including the gas produced.

subtopics.name: Forming salts by neutralisation
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe how a salt is formed by the neutralisation of an acid with an alkali.

subtopics.name: Measuring the rate of reaction
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe a method for measuring the rate of a chemical reaction.

subtopics.name: Changes in the rate of reaction
subtopics.learning_objective: Interpret a graph showing how the rate of a reaction changes over time.

subtopics.name: Surface area and the rate of reaction
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain the effect of surface area on the rate of a reaction using collision theory.

subtopics.name: Temperature and the rate of reaction
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain the effect of temperature on the rate of a reaction using collision theory.

subtopics.name: Concentration and the rate of reaction
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain the effect of concentration on the rate of a reaction using collision theory.

subtopics.name: Catalysts
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain how a catalyst increases the rate of a reaction without being used up.

subtopics.name: The idea of density
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain density as the mass of a substance per unit volume.

subtopics.name: Measuring density
subtopics.learning_objective: Measure the mass and volume of an object to determine its density.

subtopics.name: Density calculations
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate the density, mass or volume of an object using the density formula.

subtopics.name: Pressure
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain pressure as force acting per unit area.

subtopics.name: Pressure calculations
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate pressure, force or area using the pressure formula.

subtopics.name: Pressure in gases and liquids
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain how pressure varies with depth in a liquid and with volume in a gas.

subtopics.name: The turning effect of a force
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain the turning effect of a force in terms of moments.

subtopics.name: The principle of moments
subtopics.learning_objective: Apply the principle of moments to explain when a system is balanced.

subtopics.name: Calculating moments
subtopics.learning_objective: Calculate the moment of a force, or an unknown force or distance, using the moments formula.

subtopics.name: Static electricity
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain how objects become electrically charged by the transfer of electrons.

subtopics.name: Positive and negative charge
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe how like and unlike electric charges interact with each other.

subtopics.name: Electrons on the move
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe electric current as the flow of electrons around a circuit.

subtopics.name: Conductors and insulators
subtopics.learning_objective: Classify materials as electrical conductors or insulators and explain why.

subtopics.name: Electric current in a circuit
subtopics.learning_objective: Draw and interpret simple circuit diagrams using standard symbols.

subtopics.name: Understanding electric current
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain how current behaves at different points in a series circuit.

subtopics.name: Changing circuits 1
subtopics.learning_objective: Investigate how adding components in series affects current and voltage in a circuit.

subtopics.name: Changing circuits 2
subtopics.learning_objective: Investigate how changing resistance affects current in a circuit.

subtopics.name: Components in parallel
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain how current and voltage behave in a parallel circuit.

subtopics.name: How we use energy
subtopics.learning_objective: Identify the main ways energy resources are used in everyday life.

subtopics.name: Fossil fuels
subtopics.learning_objective: Describe how fossil fuels are formed and explain the environmental impact of using them.

subtopics.name: Renewables and non-renewables
subtopics.learning_objective: Compare renewable and non-renewable energy resources in terms of availability and environmental impact.

subtopics.name: Conduction of heat
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain how heat is transferred through a solid by conduction.

subtopics.name: Convection
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain how heat is transferred through a liquid or gas by convection.

subtopics.name: Radiation
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain how heat is transferred by radiation and describe factors that affect the rate of radiation.

subtopics.name: Evaporation
subtopics.learning_objective: Explain evaporation in terms of particle theory and describe factors that affect its rate.
